stepAction.returnWork: Send back to the previous step

banner.rejectTitle: Not approving closes this memo immediately
banner.rejectBody: The memo is closed as "Not approved". The requester has to submit a new one and this cannot be undone.
banner.returnToStepBody: That step becomes the current one again, and every step completed after it is cleared so the chain runs again, because that work was based on the information being sent back. The earlier results stay in the progress log.
banner.returnToRequesterBody: The memo waits with the requester, every step is cleared, and it restarts from the first step once they send it back. If you only need more information, use a progress note instead and the status stays as it is.
banner.decideWorkBody: Confirming closes this step and moves the memo to the next one, notifying the people responsible immediately. If the work is not finished, add a progress note on the memo page instead.
banner.decideApprovalBody: Approving moves the memo to the next step immediately. If anything is missing, send it back for changes first.
